title: Valparaíso: a port city built on hills
goal: Describe Valparaíso, its hills and funiculars and its World Heritage listing, using relative clauses with a preposition.
grammar: relative clauses with prepositions and el que or lo que

items: I can describe the places and ways of Valparaíso with *en la que*, *con el que* and other prepositions with *el que*.
I can say when the first funicular opened and when UNESCO listed the city.
I can name the main words for the hills, the funiculars and the murals in Spanish.
